data.value: • Core Concept: Lightweight, text-only programs executed strictly inside a command-line interface without overhead from a graphical window. • System.Console Namespace: The built-in .NET library containing essential methods (Write, WriteLine, ReadLine) required for processing standard I/O streams. • Data Stream Execution: Directs data sequentially between keyboard input and terminal output, making it ideal for automation routines, algorithms, and backend utilities.
